title: Unequal Walking Nearly Triples Obesity Risk
hook: Unequal walking tracks nearly 3 times the obesity risk.
closing: The step gap matters because unequal activity predicts unequal health.
question: How many steps do you walk daily?

segments.say: In Hong Kong, people average 6,880 daily steps, showing how widely walking differs between countries.
Countries with the most unequal walking are nearly three times as likely to be obese.
Women walking less explains 43 percent of the activity gap, showing inequality inside countries too.
